headline: Ukraine still lacks another $4 billion to cover budget deficit – Zelensky
summary: Ukraine has not yet found approximately $4 billion to cover its budget needs, President Volodymyr Zelensky stated. The statement comes amid continuing war-related financing pressures.
why: Budget financing gaps determine how much external support Ukraine needs to keep public services and the state running. Sovereign financing conditions matter for Ukrainian debt and the currency.
